title: The challenge
lines: Build the tool your business keeps wishing it had.

title: Build with AI
lines: Spend seven days building something you can use: a website that takes orders, an app that tracks customers, or a tool that saves you hours of repeat work. We teach you how to build it with AI, even if you have never written code.

title: For your business
lines: Build the customer tracker, booking app or website your business needs. Start with one job you want to make easier.

title: For your own project
lines: Build a tool for your work or a client. You will learn a skill you can keep using after the challenge.

title: Project ideas
lines: Bring the idea you keep coming back to. These examples are a starting point. We will help you choose the part to build and test in seven days.

title: Your website and tools
lines: We will help you make your tool look and sound like the business it serves. You will check it on a phone and learn how to protect customer details before sharing it. You can change an AI-generated design that feels generic.

title: What your place includes
lines: Your place includes two live 90-minute workshops, daily building exercises, starter templates, group guidance and a final review. You work on one project throughout the seven days, with help as you build.

title: Your working first version
lines: A first version does one useful job from start to finish. For a booking app, that means someone chooses a time and the booking appears in your schedule. We agree on your project’s main job before you begin and test it together at the end.

title: The ads lesson
lines: We will help you prepare an offer, an ad and the page people visit after clicking. You will leave with a way to record enquiries and see which become customers. Learn how to prepare your first campaign and decide which results to measure.

title: Your places
lines: Every place includes both live workshops, daily exercises, help with your build and the ChatGPT Ads lesson.

title: Getting set up
lines: Our team guides you through choosing and setting up what your project needs. Your challenge place covers the training and guidance. AI subscriptions, hosting and any ads you choose to run are paid separately.

title: Join the cohort
lines: Join the cohort. Bring your idea.
